title: Calibre Hands-On AI Interactive Writing: The E-book Manager Turns into a Text Adventure Game Engine
excerpt: Open-source e-book management tool Calibre has updated to version 9.15, adding a creative new feature—optional AI interactive writing game "Create Your Own Adve
content_html:
Open-source e-book management tool Calibre has updated to version 9.15, adding a creative new feature—optional AI interactive writing game "Create Your Own Adventure."

This game is hidden by default and does not appear when Calibre starts. Users need to actively bring it to the main toolbar by selecting "Preferences — Toolbar and Menu," which officially activates it. The gameplay is clear: AI builds and manages a fictional world in the background, and users push the story forward by continuously entering text, effectively turning "reading e-books" into "writing a story with AI."
